Tasks

A full exam in order. Each vessel is ticked automatically when you hold a good signal on it for about 1.5 seconds, and its values are saved.

    Each press of "Save image" (F2 or S) stores the spectrum with its values. Images are kept until the page is closed.

    Bifurcations and junctions

    JunctionDepthWhat you see

    Adult values from accepted tables (Aaslid; Alexandrov). Pathology thresholds from SONIA, Lindegaard and TIBI criteria. 3D skull model: NIH 3D Print Exchange (CC BY). Values vary with age, haematocrit, CO₂ and between labs. A teaching tool only, not a clinical device.

    1. Calibrate from a patient photo

    Photograph the side of the head, then mark the tragus and then the lateral canthus (outer eye corner).

    2. Pair the phone

    Scan with the phone. On the phone: "Enable sensors", hold the top edge on the window and press "Zero".
